author: Mike Kasberg
units: mm assumed; corroborated by source sheet dimensions, STL contains no units
sourceDefects: 27 edge-adjacent components, nonwatertight. Used as design reference only; original CSG reconstruction, no automatic repair.

mapping.socket: 4.50 mm retained length; sheet + proposed total allowance .10–.30 mm
mapping.tongue: 4.50 minus total allowance long; sheet wide; shoulder and flush-bed tip
mapping.runners: Original carrier with 20 accessible .4–.6 mm bed-level runners, wider than source for printable reliability
mapping.newGeometry: Five-part quarter-turn writing stencil. Exact orbit-selected holes, six tongue sockets, two side guides and one end register. No imported source triangles.

differences: Not a prior kit reskin: new stencil aperture orbit combinatorics and verified four-registration coverage. Grille is lift-off; not an iris, radial optical screen, tangram, loom or rotating captive fidget. Reuses local Daily Object Lab editor/import/validation infrastructure only.

design.assembly: Seat/glue three guides in six sockets, cure, lay paper, lower stencil, write, lift, quarter-turn, lower. Repeat four turns.
